title: A playthrough of a lernapps interactive app
description: A file src/playthroughs/<name>.yaml of an app built from the archetype interactive: what a learner does, from the start of a route with a seed: inputs (keys typed, actions of the app's root component) and time passing (ticks), and after each step what is expected: the state of the core (the fields named, compared with the state step(state, input) and tick(state, dt) give) or the announcement for screen readers (@lernapps/tooling/a11y), or both. The build plays every playthrough against the core and fails with one line per mismatch; the end-to-end tests play the same inputs and ticks in the browser. In both, no time passes but the ticks a step names.

route.description: The route it starts at, an id of routes in src/app.yaml; the first route when it names none.

seed.description: The seed it starts with: start(seed, route); in the browser the address app/?seed=<seed>#<route>.

step.description: What happens: keys or inputs, then ticks, at least one of them; then what is expected after them: state, announce, or both.

keys.description: Keys, one after the other, each as the browser names it (KeyboardEvent.key): a, A, Enter, " " for the space bar, ArrowLeft. The short form of inputs that are all keys; a step has keys or inputs, not both.

inputs.description: Inputs, one after the other: a key ({ kind: key, key: a }), pressed on the keyboard in the browser, or an action of the app's root component ({ kind: action, name: again }, with a value if it has one), emitted by the root component as input in the browser.

ticks.description: The ticks that pass after the keys or inputs: tick(state, TICK) that many times, TICK = 20 ms, so 50 ticks are a second.

state.description: The state expected after the step: the fields named, each compared in the same way; a list or any other value is compared as a whole.

announce.description: The announcement expected after the step, in German: what @lernapps/tooling/a11y's announce said last. Only the browser can see it.

input.description: An input to the core: step(state, input). Told apart by kind.

key.description: A key, as the browser names it (KeyboardEvent.key).

action.description: An action the app's root component emits as input, for what the learner does with the pointer or by touch.

name.description: The name the app gives the action.

value.description: The JSON value the action carries, if it needs one.
